decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposal would result in the loss of the employment use of this site contrary to Policy E.1.1a of the Adopted Unitary Development Plan (1996) and Policy E.1.5 of the Revised Unitary Development Plan (2001).

Condition : 2 - The proposal fails to provide affordable housing and is therefore contrary to Policy H.2.1 of the Proposed Unitary Development Plan (2001) and Supplementary Planning Guidance: Affordable Housing (2002).

Condition : 3 - The proposal is unacceptable on the basis that:
(a)	There is inadequate car parking provision or a contribution towards a controlled parking zone
(b)	There is inadequate cycle parking provision, which would not reduce reliance on the private car;
(c)	There is inadequate provision to increase the safety and security of pedestrians and cyclists.
	It would thereby be contrary to Policies T.1.4, T.2.1, T.2.2, T.2.3 of the Proposed Unitary Development Plan (2001) and Policies T.2.5, T.3.1, T.3.4, T.3.5 of the Adopted Unitary Development Plan (1996).

Condition : 4 - The proposal would provide inadequate amenity space. This would thereby be contrary to Policies ENV.1.1 and H.1.2 of the Adopted Unitary Development Plan and Policies ENV-B.1.1 and H.4.1 and Appendix 5 of the Revised Deposit Unitary Development Plan (2001).
description: Change of use from office (B1) to 8 residential flats (C3)
